t: Obstacle Detection Engine - public implementations survey
title: Obstacle Detection Engine - public implementations survey

description:

When a build calls for Obstacle Detection Engine, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.
